purpose: Contract for compact context packs injected into the host CLI model.
mode_pack_policy: Mode context packs are loaded only when the UI/user activates a mode. They are not separate skills.
worker_orchestrator_policy: Context packs may point the host model to a deterministic worker plan. Workers gather and score evidence; only the host CLI model produces final user-visible coaching text.
specialist_agent_policy: Context packs may expose optional CLI-native specialist subagent lanes for complex/background analysis. Specialist agents inherit the host CLI model by default, return structured packets only, and must never produce final user-visible coaching text.
season_module_policy: Context packs expose the active season module, but runtime session/mode/output rules must stay season-invariant.
retention_budget_policy: Context packs remind the host model that raw frames/full live_state retention is debug-only and normal match artifacts must stay compact.
json_io_policy: All context pack artifacts are written by Node as UTF-8 no-BOM JSON/Markdown.
